notes.title: The new Chapter 1 demo is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
TVI has a new demo! Watch the trailer here:[previewyoutube="9WD1G0BxFbU;full"][/previewyoutube]One month to go!!
The Victor Initiative releases in roughly one month, so to celebrate I've created a new demo version of the game which properly shows it off! The previous demo was very old, so even if you've played it I urge that you give this new demo a shot. Make sure to leave your feedback in the steam discussion forums too, I try to check them every day!

Have fun!!!
Spacepiano :D

notes.title: Sam Lake joins the Initiative!
notes.content:
I'm incredibly excited to announce that Sam Lake will have a cameo appearance in The Victor Initiative!
For those not in the know, Sam Lake is the creator of the stories of Max Payne 1&2, Alan Wake 1&2, Quantum Break and Control! You might also know him as the face of Max Payne in Max Payne 1, or the face of Alex Casey in Alan Wake 2!


This is an incredible milestone for the game, and I'll have further cast announcements down the line with even more surprises in store! Watch the trailer below for more info, and keep your eyes peeled for a release date soon!


[previewyoutube="rATaBQcargw;full"][/previewyoutube]


See you on the other side!
Spacepiano ;D
